immigration.text: Humphrey supports securing the border and enforcing immigration law while also calling for legal immigration to be fixed.
immigration.quote:
A nation should know who is entering its borders.

Secure the border. Enforce the law. Fix legal immigration.

Congress has had decades to do all three.

tax.text: Peterson said she supports keeping taxes low for everyone.
tax.quote: I’m a Conservative that believes in our God-given freedoms, Republican Principles, preserving our American freedoms, allowing free markets, keeping low taxes for all, boosting a strong U.S. economy, peace through strength, opportunity for all, while standing up for everyday Americans

safety.text: Peterson said she supports fully funding police.
safety.quote: I back supporting and FULL 100% FUNDING our POLICE.

immigration.text: Peterson said people who entered the country illegally and committed crimes must be returned to their home countries.
immigration.quote: Criminal offenders who have entered illegally must return to their country. The crime from illegals is unfair to citizens, allow such is just as bad.

guns.text: Peterson supports protecting the Second Amendment and the right to bear arms without infringement.
guns.quote: Yes to protecting the 2nd amendment; right to bear arms without infringement.

voting.text: Peterson called for in-person Election Day voting with citizenship identification, paper ballots and hand counts, and said mail ballots attract fraud.
voting.quote: Mail in ballots attract fraud, phone voting will not be secure. Voting must return to same day, in person, American citizen ID provided, paper ballot and hand count.

tax.text: Kiros supports raising the corporate tax rate above 50%.
tax.quote: tax rate should be raised back above 50%.

housing.text: Kiros supports zoning and permitting reform to accelerate construction, along with publicly built social housing.
housing.quote: She supports zoning and permitting reform to speed up housing construction.

schools.text: Kiros calls for investing in public schools and paying teachers a living wage.
schools.quote: need to invest in public schools, pay teachers

immigration.quote: replace it with a humane, accountable immigration system focused on genuine public safety

guns.text: Kiros supports universal background checks, red-flag laws and bans on assault weapons and high-capacity magazines.
guns.quote: the foundation of any serious gun safety system.

health.text: Kiros supports passing Medicare for All.
health.quote: No one should suffer or go bankrupt because they can’t afford healthcare.

energy.text: Kiros supports fully funding renewable energy and transitioning to a zero-emissions power grid.
energy.quote: Fully funding renewable energy development and transitioning to a zero-emissions energy grid.

voting.text: Kiros supports the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.
voting.quote: Kiros also emphasized voting rights, namely supporting the John Lewis Voting Rights Act

tax.text: Blau said he favors lower taxes for everyone and opposes tax increases.
tax.quote: I believe in lower taxes for everyone. I'm not in favor of raising taxes.

immigration.text: Blau supports both securing the border and making legal immigration faster and more efficient.
immigration.quote: Secure our borders while building a faster, more efficient legal immigration system. Honest problem solving, not slogans.
